outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative bright-field and ICG fluorescence photographs of lungs; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel B is a bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity (mean ± SD) with individual data points (blue and red dots for each mouse) overlaid on the bars, satisfying the requirement.

Panel C consists of H&E and fluorescence/RNAscope micrographs and spatial expression heatmap-style plots (Cd68, Spp1); these are not summary bar/line plots of averaged replicate data requiring individual points, so the check does not apply.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment score line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement (line plots).

Panel E is a bar graph showing log2 fold-change values (derived from differential expression analysis across many cells/spots) for multiple genes, with only bars and p-values shown; no individual data points are overlaid to show the underlying distribution.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC micrographs/photographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
